title: jstack playbook compute --json
description: One playbook after every layer's edits are applied in cascade order.

path.description: Team files read through a checkout are relative to its root (.agents/playbooks/<file>); every other path is absolute.

status.description: skipped when the repo has no .agents/playbooks or it holds a broken link.

lines.description: pstack's check-playbooks.mjs output, verbatim, or the reason it did not run.

repo.description: Repo key: the name part of the origin remote, or the --repo value. null outside a repo.

owner.description: Owner part of the origin remote. null when unknown.

org.description: The layers.json orgs entry that owns the repo. null when none does.

pstack.description: pstack version the bundled playbooks came from.

text.description: The step with every edit applied and replaced text removed. Step N is index N-1.

origin.description: The layer that created the step.

touched.description: Layers that edited the step with In or Replace, in cascade order.

overrides.description: Each In or Replace by a layer later in the cascade than the step's origin.

over.description: A lower layer whose Replace of the same words this one supersedes.

handoffs.description: Each other playbook the steps or notes hand off to, in order of first mention. Only references that resolve to a known playbook appear; check reports the rest.

playbook.description: Stem of the playbook handed off to. Compute it too.

steps.description: Steps that name it, ascending. Empty when only notes do.

inNotes.description: true when a note names it.

problems.description: Validator findings in files that target this playbook, plus every broken link.
